menuNameInEngine.evidence: SkyUI SKI_SettingsManager.psc:7 INVENTORY_MENU = "InventoryMenu" used in RegisterForMenu (:42), which only works with the engine's registered name; MagicMenu.as:120,:157 skse.OpenMenu("InventoryMenu").
menuNameInEngine.notes: ItemMenu.as:485 uses skse.OpenMenu("Inventory Menu") (with a space). Likely a SkyUI bug on a rare path (resetMenu); not used as evidence. Needs an in-game check.

confidenceLevels.high: Same name and signature in vanilla and SkyUI, and its role (engine->AS bridge, or nothing in AS calls or fills it) points at the executable.
confidenceLevels.medium: Present in both but only AS-internal use is visible, or the engine role is inferred from one side.
confidenceLevels.low: Recall or a single source; needs an in-game check.
confidenceLevels.none: Differs between vanilla and SkyUI, so the engine cannot depend on it.

stage.evidence: Vanilla and SkyUI both 1280x720 px, SWF v15, 11 root frames. Frame rate differs (vanilla 30, SkyUI 60), so frame rate is not engine-required.
stage.notes: Size is a convention both share; SkyUI sets Stage.scaleMode = "showAll" itself (ItemMenu.as:46). Treat as a lint warning, not an error.

instances.evidence: Neither SWF ever pushes into the item list's entryList (vanilla only fills CategoriesList and ItemCard's own list; SkyUI only fills categoryList), yet both read itemList.entryList in InvalidateListData. So the engine fills it through the object GetInventoryItemList returns. Vanilla returns InventoryLists_mc.ItemsList (BSScrollingList, get entryList at BSScrollingList.as:234); SkyUI returns inventoryLists.itemList (BSList get entryList, BSList.as:11).
instances.notes: The engine reaches the list by the returned object, not by a path, so its instance name is free. It must expose an Array named entryList. Entry fields seen read in vanilla: text, count, enabled, disabled, equipState, favorite, filterFlag, bestInClass, isStealing, negativeEffect, soulLVL (data, not names in the SWF; see unknown.entryFields).

instances.evidence: Placed on the root at depth 1, frame 1 in both (vanilla char 121, SkyUI char 8). The only verified users are the root frame scripts, which forward InitExtensions/SetPlatform/GetInventoryItemList to it.
instances.notes: No evidence that the executable resolves _root.Menu_mc itself. Keep the name anyway: other plugins and Papyrus UI.Invoke paths tend to assume it (recall, not verified for this menu). Candidate for a base-layer or compatibility rule.

functions.name: ExternalInterface callback "call"
functions.evidence: gfx.io.GameDelegate.initialize registers ExternalInterface.addCallback("call", GameDelegate, receiveCall) in both (vanilla GameDelegate.as:59, SkyUI compiled GameDelegate.as:60). receiveCall dispatches to addCallBack handlers; nothing in AS invokes it.
functions.notes: This is how every entry in callbacks[] arrives. An unregistered name is a silent no-op (receiveCall returns undefined).

functions.name: ExternalInterface.call(methodName, uid, ...args)
functions.evidence: GameDelegate.call unshifts (methodName, nextID) onto params and calls ExternalInterface.call.apply (vanilla GameDelegate.as:19). Identical in SkyUI.
functions.notes: Wire format for every entry with direction as->engine below. Replacements should reuse gfx.io.GameDelegate rather than reimplement it.

functions.name: ExternalInterface callback "respond"
functions.evidence: Registered next to "call" in both; receiveResponse looks up responseHash[uid] and applies scope[callBack]. Used by RequestItemCardInfo and CheckForMouseEquip.
functions.notes: The response handler name is chosen by AS, not the engine: vanilla and SkyUI pass UpdateItemCardInfo, SkyUI's ItemcardDataExtender.as:12 passes updateItemInfo.

functions.name: CheckForMouseEquip
functions.response: engine replies via respond; both point it at AttemptEquip
functions.evidence: Vanilla InventoryMenu.as:204, SkyUI InventoryMenu.as:187, same args.

functions.notes: The SWF closes itself (Tab handling is in AS), so without this call the menu cannot be closed from the UI.

functions.name: GetInventoryItemList
functions.evidence: Defined as a root-frame-1 function in both SWFs with identical text (vanilla frame_1/DoAction.as; SkyUI data/interface/inventorymenu.swf frame_1, matching source/swf/inventorymenu.xml:173). No AS code calls it.

functions.name: InitExtensions
functions.evidence: Root-frame-1 function in both, forwarding to Menu_mc.InitExtensions(); no AS caller. Both register their GameDelegate callbacks inside it, so callbacks only work once the engine has called it.
functions.notes: Vanilla ItemMenu.InitExtensions takes abPlayBladeSound, but the root wrapper passes nothing, so the engine passes no args through the root.

functions.name: SetPlatform
functions.evidence: Root-frame-1 function in both with the same parameter names; no AS caller.
functions.notes: Platform values seen in vanilla: 0 = PC, 7 = NX mouse (PLATFORM_NX_MOUSE), 6 = NX; vanilla treats 0 and 7 as mouse platforms.

callbacks.name: AttemptEquip
callbacks.notes: Also the response target of CheckForMouseEquip in both.

callbacks.name: InvalidateListData
callbacks.notes: Signals that the engine has (re)filled the item list's entryList. Both then call itemList.InvalidateData() and recompute category filterFlag from entry filterFlag & category flag.

callbacks.name: ItemRotating
callbacks.notes: Cosmetic (zoom button feedback); a missing handler is a silent no-op.

callbacks.name: RestoreIndices
callbacks.evidence: Vanilla ItemMenu.as:27,:309-319 reads arguments[0] then one per category; SkyUI ItemMenu.as:59,:199-235 expects exactly 5. Each reads back the shape it saved.
callbacks.notes: Name is engine-required; argument shape is SWF-defined (engine echoes SaveIndices). SkyUI falls back when length != 5, so it survives a vanilla-shaped save.

callbacks.name: SetButtonMapping
callbacks.evidence: Vanilla only: Shared/ButtonMapping.as:40, used by vanilla BottomBar.as:29,:436. SkyUI's inventory does not register it.
callbacks.notes: SkyUI works without it, so it is optional. The engine probably sends it (vanilla registers it); not verified.

callbacks.name: SetCategoriesList
callbacks.evidence: Vanilla InventoryLists.as:26,:250-271; SkyUI InventoryLists.as:39,:221-250. Both read the same triples; flag == 0 marks a divider.

callbacks.name: ToggleMenuFade
callbacks.evidence: Vanilla ItemMenu.as:26; SkyUI ItemMenu.as:58. Both implement it as _parent.gotoAndPlay("fadeOut"/"fadeIn").

callbacks.name: UpdateItemCardInfo
callbacks.evidence: Vanilla ItemMenu.as:25; SkyUI ItemMenu.as:57. Also the respond target for RequestItemCardInfo in both.
callbacks.notes: Info fields read by vanilla ItemCard/BottomBar: type, name, upperCaseName, value, weight, armor, damage, warmth, effects, charge, currentCharge, totalCharges, usedCharge, stolen, poisoned, soulLVL, description, skillName, skillText, castLevel, castTime, spellCost, timeRemaining, listItems, sliderShown, count, negativeEffect, numItemEffects.

frameLabels.label: fadeIn
frameLabels.evidence: Root frame 7 in both. Only AS seeks it (ItemMenu.ToggleMenuFade: _parent.gotoAndPlay("fadeIn")).
frameLabels.notes: The engine triggers the fade by the ToggleMenuFade callback, not by seeking labels. Root frame 1 DoAction calls Menu_mc.SetFadedIn(); frame 6 DoAction calls Menu_mc.onFadeCompletion(); same in both.

frameLabels.label: fadeOut
frameLabels.evidence: Root frame 2 in both. Only AS seeks it (ToggleMenuFade).
